lastCompletedStory.title: Deterministic regression test for the zero-dep smoke

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a deterministic regression test (test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts) that materializes the embedded smoke in a fresh tmpdir, runs git init, writes a minimal .claude/agents/example.md fixture, and invokes via spawnSync('bun', [scriptPath]). The F-02 oracle (BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR empty) passes because the smoke now uses only node: built-ins. US-003 adds defensive hardening of in-repo js-yaml default imports + a runbook note.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 only adds a test file using built-in node:fs/node:child_process and the repo-internal _generated.ts. No new external library is exercised.
